changelog: **Nudge rules engine (#1684):** new `NudgeRule` / `NudgeSend` models (tenant-registered) and the evaluator in `src/lib/nudges/`. A rule fires on an allowlisted non-stage domain event (`nudge` subscriber; the relation's mentor and mentee are the candidates, `delayMinutes` sets the send's `runAt`) or on the daily `nudge.evaluate` scan (09:20 UTC). Segments are allowlisted `{field, op, value}` conditions translated to Prisma only in `segment.ts`; stage-change triggers are refused at write time (that is `AutomationRule`, #1703). Hard limits in code: no nudge to a dormant first contact (no third dormancy mail) and none to a mentee at an outcome/terminal stage. Per-person caps (`maxPerUserPer30Days`, `cooldownDays`) count every nudge in the org; dedupe is the `NudgeSend` row, claimed before the send. Mail goes through `sendEmail()` under the new `nudge` category (`task_reminders` group, held by outbound approval for leads); in-app through `notifyIfAllowed()`. Also adds the missing `webhook.deliver` to `JOB_NAMES`. Docs: `docs/nudges.md`.
